title: Runway Briefing: Burbank's Tower Goes Dark, United Bets Big on Cleveland, and Qantas Paints a Dog on a Superjumbo
summary: Pilots at Burbank had to play air traffic controller themselves when the tower just... emptied out. Plus, United makes a surprising comeback at a hub it abandoned over a decade ago, Boeing's two oldest jets head in completely opposite directions, and Qantas slaps Bluey on an A380 because of course it does.
